import math

N = 86
M = 171
T = []
for i in range(N + 1):
    t_i = math.floor(M * i / N)
    T.append(t_i)

# T is the sequence t_0, t_1, ..., t_86
# S = { t_i + t_j | 0 <= i <= j <= 86 }
S = set()
for i in range(len(T)):
    for j in range(i, len(T)):
        sum_val = T[i] + T[j]
        S.add(sum_val)

size_S = len(S)

print(f"The sequence T is: {T}")
print(f"The size of the sumset S is: {size_S}")
